summary: Telefónica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing minutes of its 537th Board of Directors meeting held November 5, 2026. The board acknowledged the resignation, effective November 6, 2026, of Ignacio Maria Moreno Martínez from the board and the Audit and Control Committee, and appointed Ernesto Daniel Gardelliano to the board as his replacement until ratification at the next general shareholders meeting, with the term running through the 2028 AGM. This is a routine board-seat succession, not a forced or abrupt executive departure, and no transaction terms, advisors or regulatory clocks apply.
